name: StemWave of Bend
old_description: StemWave™ utilizes harmless, yet powerful acoustic waves to activate the body's natural healing mechanisms.
about:
StemWave of Bend operates in Bend, Oregon, under the direction of Dr. Jeff Finnigan. The clinic provides acoustic wave therapy treatments using the StemWave™ system.

The clinic delivers non-invasive, drug-free treatments that use acoustic waves to stimulate the body's natural healing mechanisms. Sessions last five to ten minutes and require no recovery time. Treatment areas include the neck and back, upper extremities such as shoulders, elbows, and wrists, lower extremities including knees, ankles, and feet, and soft tissues such as muscles, tendons, and ligaments.

Patients seek treatment for chronic aches, mobility limitations, and soft-tissue injuries. Testimonials on the site describe outcomes such as a return to walking eight miles after being unable to walk 100 yards, and regained ability to run up and down stairs.

The company emphasizes its FDA-listed status, the speed and affordability of treatments, and the absence of drugs or downtime as key differentiators.
